content:
Aisha N: quick ask — where's the dashboard/panel that overlays SM% + SM throughput + KV-cache eviction rate by GPU pool? also want a batch-size histogram per-pool if available. prepping a short PM and want exact links/panel ids.

Ben T: inference-gpu-summary board. Panel title 'Pool SM% + throughput + KV evictions'. Grafana UID `Z9kLm3Q`, panel id 9. Direct link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/Z9kLm3Q/inference-gpu-summary?orgId=1&viewPanel=9

Charlie R: FYI we had a noticeable tail on 2024-12-07 04:12 UTC — evictions spiked right after the ad-hoc eval ramp. That panel shows SM% drop + eviction bump side-by-side.

Aisha N: perfect. which alert paged during that window? want to propose a change to reduce noise (it paged twice for short burst).

Ben T: alerts are in infra monitor rules: monitoring/alerts/gpu-evictions.yml. Current rule (simplified):

```
increase(kvcache_evictions_total{env="prod"}[2m]) > 5
```

Ben T: small window + low threshold = noisy during short eval spikes.

Charlie R: suggestion: use a 12m increase window and OR a sustained rate threshold. e.g.

```
increase(kvcache_evictions_total{env="prod"}[12m]) > 12
OR
rate(kvcache_evictions_total{env="prod"}[10m]) > 0.02
```

Aisha N: that sounds reasonable. can someone open an infra PR and attach a panel JSON export and a tiny runbook note for the dashboard (expected nightly/eviction pattern -> what to ignore vs escalate)?

Ben T: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/621 — changes alert to 12m/rate combo, uploads a panel JSON and adds dashboard note + runbook snippet. I also added a new histogram panel (panel 31) showing per-pool request batch-size distribution (tokens/request buckets).

Aisha N: awesome. Ops — do we still have Datadog monitors that page for this class? need IDs to annotate the timeline.

MetricsBot: Datadog monitors: `dd_gpu_sm_412` (SM util), `dd_kvcache_evictions_88` (evictions). Link: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors

Charlie R: for traces: APM -> Traces, filter service=gpu-runtime and span=kvcache.*. Example search: https://tracing.redwood.com/search?service=gpu-runtime&span=kvcache.lookup — open traces from the Grafana series context menu.

Aisha N: great, I'll add a few trace examples to the PM and mark PR #621 as the mitigation. Ben, can you paste the exported panel JSON into the PR assets so we can reuse in staging?

Ben T: done — panel JSON attached in PR + instructions to import to staging. Also added a one-paragraph runbook blurb on the dashboard (how to inspect 1h/6h windows, enable raw series and open traces).

InfraBot: CI for infra PR 621 passed; awaiting LGTM from infra oncall.

Aisha N: perfect — I'll wait for merge, run the repro in staging, and then finalize the PM. closing once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
